107c0660f047dc668adf4c35c7a89dcc.name: Cisboatontable synth
107c0660f047dc668adf4c35c7a89dcc.en: Multiple glider recipes, all ending in a cis-boat and table.
107c0660f047dc668adf4c35c7a89dcc.pt: Várias receitas com planadores, todas terminando num cis-boat and table.

0dd3aa7fb38592bc918861eb66ab34be.name: Coe ship synth
0dd3aa7fb38592bc918861eb66ab34be.en: A glider recipe that assembles the Coe ship.
0dd3aa7fb38592bc918861eb66ab34be.pt: Uma receita com planadores que monta a Coe ship.

0b8b6e5b9b9ad6eb51b2ad362744edc0.name: Cuphook synth
0b8b6e5b9b9ad6eb51b2ad362744edc0.en: Gliders collide to construct a cuphook.
0b8b6e5b9b9ad6eb51b2ad362744edc0.pt: Planadores colidem para construir um cuphook.

168243ac9d525391d598eb3422d0976c.name: Domino synth
168243ac9d525391d598eb3422d0976c.en: Gliders collide to make a domino, a short-lived pair of cells; the whole reaction is gone after 16 generations.
168243ac9d525391d598eb3422d0976c.pt: Planadores colidem para formar um dominó, um par de células de vida curta; tudo desaparece após 16 gerações.

1430fb30b0578c13c1418536b8f04676.name: eater4 synth
1430fb30b0578c13c1418536b8f04676.en: Gliders are combined to build eater 4.
1430fb30b0578c13c1418536b8f04676.pt: Planadores são combinados para construir o eater 4.

48a3abd06e2a43cb6782750c8e4709b1.name: Eureka synth
48a3abd06e2a43cb6782750c8e4709b1.en: Twelve gliders combine to build Eureka.
48a3abd06e2a43cb6782750c8e4709b1.pt: Doze planadores se combinam para construir o Eureka.

0b16a73d87ba8fbe748131a9f6bae2b9.name: Fourteener synth
0b16a73d87ba8fbe748131a9f6bae2b9.en: Several glider recipes for the fourteener.
0b16a73d87ba8fbe748131a9f6bae2b9.pt: Várias receitas com planadores para o fourteener.

12dfe4e36472db096abcaee70dbcfea4.name: Glider-producing switch engine synth
12dfe4e36472db096abcaee70dbcfea4.en: Gliders collide to create a switch engine that emits gliders as it goes, so the pattern never stops growing.
12dfe4e36472db096abcaee70dbcfea4.pt: Planadores colidem para criar um switch engine que solta planadores pelo caminho, e o padrão nunca para de crescer.

0c94eea0653e2c6884e384342b2ac476.name: Hat synth
0c94eea0653e2c6884e384342b2ac476.en: Glider recipes that build the hat.
0c94eea0653e2c6884e384342b2ac476.pt: Receitas com planadores que constroem o hat (chapéu).

060e929ee37e6b5e1c1f116da3961cd6.name: Hivenudger synth
060e929ee37e6b5e1c1f116da3961cd6.en: A glider recipe that assembles a hivenudger.
060e929ee37e6b5e1c1f116da3961cd6.pt: Uma receita com planadores que monta um hivenudger.

188eca3ed42c95cc062538897295fae5.name: Hustler synth
188eca3ed42c95cc062538897295fae5.en: Gliders are brought together to build the hustler.
188eca3ed42c95cc062538897295fae5.pt: Planadores se juntam para construir o hustler.

2752029a7082c417c3f40ee2fce38c12.name: jasonsp36caterers synth
2752029a7082c417c3f40ee2fce38c12.en: Twenty-eight gliders build Jason's p36 in its version with caterers.
2752029a7082c417c3f40ee2fce38c12.pt: Vinte e oito planadores constroem o Jason's p36 na versão com caterers.

18ba63782f0930c7a8d149b4629926dd.name: Light bulb synth
18ba63782f0930c7a8d149b4629926dd.en: Gliders collide to build a light bulb.
18ba63782f0930c7a8d149b4629926dd.pt: Planadores colidem para construir uma light bulb (lâmpada).

02530e6e8f13d10758bb9eb50a05728a.name: Long barge synth
02530e6e8f13d10758bb9eb50a05728a.en: A glider recipe that yields a long barge.
02530e6e8f13d10758bb9eb50a05728a.pt: Uma receita com planadores que gera uma long barge.

3b9f0953c01991d3316334005453e0a4.name: Long ship synth
3b9f0953c01991d3316334005453e0a4.en: Several glider recipes, each producing a long ship.
3b9f0953c01991d3316334005453e0a4.pt: Várias receitas com planadores, cada uma produzindo um long ship.

1ebbf18c94bc756d419cc17769db8b7e.name: Loop synth
1ebbf18c94bc756d419cc17769db8b7e.en: Four gliders collide to build a loop.
1ebbf18c94bc756d419cc17769db8b7e.pt: Quatro planadores colidem para construir um loop.

162779bec60b7527db7690053c68364b.name: Mold and long hook eating tub synth
162779bec60b7527db7690053c68364b.en: Twenty gliders collide to build a mold plus a long hook eating tub.
162779bec60b7527db7690053c68364b.pt: Vinte planadores colidem para construir um mold junto de um long hook eating tub.

0acbb31f979b7e095ce6ea4d569329f1.name: Noahsark synth
0acbb31f979b7e095ce6ea4d569329f1.en: A glider recipe that assembles Noah's ark.
0acbb31f979b7e095ce6ea4d569329f1.pt: Uma receita com planadores que monta a Noah's ark (arca de Noé).

13851a907003a8382263a3f7770d8b76.name: p156gun synth
13851a907003a8382263a3f7770d8b76.en: Gliders collide to build a glider gun of period 156, which then keeps firing.
13851a907003a8382263a3f7770d8b76.pt: Planadores colidem para montar um canhão de planadores de período 156, que então passa a disparar.

223940401ca919de4a062d2f1e74f5cd.name: p60bheptominohassler synth
223940401ca919de4a062d2f1e74f5cd.en: Twenty-eight gliders build a B-heptomino hassler, an oscillator that keeps perturbing a B-heptomino.
223940401ca919de4a062d2f1e74f5cd.pt: Vinte e oito planadores constroem um hassler de B-heptominó, oscilador que perturba sem parar um B-heptominó.

02d9e99bf605ebebbc16ffe15f14f251.name: Pentant synth
02d9e99bf605ebebbc16ffe15f14f251.en: Twenty-nine gliders collide to construct the pentant.
02d9e99bf605ebebbc16ffe15f14f251.pt: Vinte e nove planadores colidem para construir o pentant.

200d83fbbc54556195cb1070e6ce024d.name: phoenix1 synth
200d83fbbc54556195cb1070e6ce024d.en: A glider recipe that builds phoenix 1.
200d83fbbc54556195cb1070e6ce024d.pt: Uma receita com planadores que constrói o phoenix 1.

00d18000d9e2b63850d64b83b74ba39a.name: Pre-block synth
00d18000d9e2b63850d64b83b74ba39a.en: Several ways of producing a pre-block with gliders.
00d18000d9e2b63850d64b83b74ba39a.pt: Várias formas de produzir um pre-block com planadores.

664b3a27257994b598a80031eda8ab7f.name: pushalong1 synth
664b3a27257994b598a80031eda8ab7f.en: A glider recipe that builds pushalong 1.
664b3a27257994b598a80031eda8ab7f.pt: Uma receita com planadores que constrói o pushalong 1.

7dcd4aef14e2340ab6ce49ec60f80311.name: Richsp16 synth
7dcd4aef14e2340ab6ce49ec60f80311.en: Gliders collide to build Rich's p16.
7dcd4aef14e2340ab6ce49ec60f80311.pt: Planadores colidem para construir o Rich's p16.

47a415c49be74b07ce0e88ca1d1f3f7f.name: Ship on long boat synth
47a415c49be74b07ce0e88ca1d1f3f7f.en: Several glider recipes for the ship on long boat.
47a415c49be74b07ce0e88ca1d1f3f7f.pt: Várias receitas com planadores para o ship on long boat.

81ece487a2c6a4c573ba58555f42867c.name: Sixls synth
81ece487a2c6a4c573ba58555f42867c.en: Eighteen gliders collide to build six L's.
81ece487a2c6a4c573ba58555f42867c.pt: Dezoito planadores colidem para construir o six L's.

06250aa52c5597ba15cf40fc51fec13b.name: Snake siamese snake synth
06250aa52c5597ba15cf40fc51fec13b.en: A glider recipe producing the snake siamese snake.
06250aa52c5597ba15cf40fc51fec13b.pt: Uma receita com planadores que produz o snake siamese snake.

563a222e09bd11f8fc7648048c61c52e.name: Star synth
563a222e09bd11f8fc7648048c61c52e.en: Twenty gliders build the star oscillator.
563a222e09bd11f8fc7648048c61c52e.pt: Vinte planadores constroem o oscilador star.

2a0b07feef7eaeeca64e16e30ece51b7.name: Thirteenloop synth
2a0b07feef7eaeeca64e16e30ece51b7.en: Four gliders suffice to form a thirteen loop.
2a0b07feef7eaeeca64e16e30ece51b7.pt: Quatro planadores bastam para formar um thirteen loop.

143e98778be7cf744d2b2da469f29c61.name: Trans-beacon and cap synth
143e98778be7cf744d2b2da469f29c61.en: Gliders collide to build the trans-beacon and cap.
143e98778be7cf744d2b2da469f29c61.pt: Planadores colidem para construir o trans-beacon and cap.

15954279cc3aada7b030cfc6f9c9ddd0.name: Trans-mirrored R-bee synth
15954279cc3aada7b030cfc6f9c9ddd0.en: Several glider recipes for the trans-mirrored R-bee.
15954279cc3aada7b030cfc6f9c9ddd0.pt: Várias receitas com planadores para o trans-mirrored R-bee.

2091ccc9d5afd362a43b2ae4853a6d03.name: Tub with tail synth
2091ccc9d5afd362a43b2ae4853a6d03.en: Several glider recipes, each building a tub with tail.
2091ccc9d5afd362a43b2ae4853a6d03.pt: Várias receitas com planadores, cada uma construindo um tub with tail.

5060c96d293a176e8c22654b51059926.name: Two-glider mess synth
5060c96d293a176e8c22654b51059926.en: A glider recipe that recreates the two-glider mess.
5060c96d293a176e8c22654b51059926.pt: Uma receita com planadores que recria a two-glider mess.

0cdabdb78ce133eec0086c3d6dd76b08.name: Up dove on dove synthesis
0cdabdb78ce133eec0086c3d6dd76b08.en: A glider recipe that builds the up dove on dove.
0cdabdb78ce133eec0086c3d6dd76b08.pt: Uma receita com planadores que constrói o up dove on dove.

440c2a3ffc6704563a0881eba94e147a.name: Weekender synth
440c2a3ffc6704563a0881eba94e147a.en: Seventy-nine gliders build a weekender; the recipe went into Chris Cain's p444 weekender gun.
440c2a3ffc6704563a0881eba94e147a.pt: Setenta e nove planadores constroem um weekender; a receita foi usada no canhão de weekenders p444 de Chris Cain.

035c6a108149a319dc8d09f67e6b4e97.name: Gardens of Eden
035c6a108149a319dc8d09f67e6b4e97.en: A collection of many Gardens of Eden, patterns that can have no predecessor, all found in 2009.
035c6a108149a319dc8d09f67e6b4e97.pt: Uma coleção de muitos Jardins do Éden (Gardens of Eden), padrões que não podem ter antecessor, todos encontrados em 2009.

209f1fb919ca2fc3d9bd3b96f1f35558.name: Mersenne prime calculator
209f1fb919ca2fc3d9bd3b96f1f35558.en: A machine built in Life that computes Mersenne primes, adapted from Jason Summers' Fermat prime calculator.
209f1fb919ca2fc3d9bd3b96f1f35558.pt: Uma máquina montada no Jogo da Vida que calcula primos de Mersenne, adaptada da calculadora de primos de Fermat de Jason Summers.

2e3f1d2f0bbeaa9309d8a70aff88d07e.name: OTCA metapixel (off)
2e3f1d2f0bbeaa9309d8a70aff88d07e.en: A giant unit cell that can emulate any Life-like cellular automaton; this is its off state.
2e3f1d2f0bbeaa9309d8a70aff88d07e.pt: Uma célula unitária gigante capaz de emular qualquer autômato celular do tipo Life; esta é a versão no estado desligado.

2fd86e169131c18f4a136504a42efcb8.name: Tlog(t) growth
2fd86e169131c18f4a136504a42efcb8.en: Grows forever, with its population increasing on the order of t·log(t).
2fd86e169131c18f4a136504a42efcb8.pt: Cresce para sempre, com a população aumentando na ordem de t·log(t).

048d5abd69e5297d94591c54ad5faa65.name: Component
048d5abd69e5297d94591c54ad5faa65.en: Builders reuse partial syntheses like this across many recipes; each changes one spot of an object and nothing else. This well-known one grows a hook on a protruding table end, giving a long bookend.
048d5abd69e5297d94591c54ad5faa65.pt: Quem monta sínteses reaproveita peças como esta em muitas receitas; cada uma muda um ponto do objeto e nada mais. Esta, bem conhecida, cria um hook numa ponta saliente de table, formando um long bookend.

13ba8e2476428b0464b6edfd07bbbe56.name: Fly-by deletion
13ba8e2476428b0464b6edfd07bbbe56.en: A convoy of spaceships flies past, wipes out a tub and continues unharmed; such tricks clean up debris in puffers and ships. Tubs seem to need an unusual period-4 ship.
13ba8e2476428b0464b6edfd07bbbe56.pt: Um comboio de naves passa, apaga um tub e segue intacto; truques assim limpam detritos em puffers e naves. Para tubs, parece ser preciso uma nave incomum de período 4.

1cd65aa4b18c8b79fa10837a7a60626b.name: Killer candlefrobras eating a HWSS
1cd65aa4b18c8b79fa10837a7a60626b.en: Two candlefrobras that behave somewhat like killer toads, waiting to devour an incoming HWSS.
1cd65aa4b18c8b79fa10837a7a60626b.pt: Dois candlefrobras que agem de modo parecido com killer toads, prestes a devorar uma nave pesada (HWSS) que se aproxima.

0d8bc26f4cb70e97b51b2652d94f3faf.name: Mirage
0d8bc26f4cb70e97b51b2652d94f3faf.en: A Gosper glider gun appears briefly and is torn down again; the whole pattern is gone by generation 73.
0d8bc26f4cb70e97b51b2652d94f3faf.pt: Um Gosper glider gun surge por pouco tempo e logo é desfeito; o padrão inteiro some até a geração 73.

35607cda4ef506c2b085d10be6019d18.name: PPS
35607cda4ef506c2b085d10be6019d18.en: The core of a pre-pulsar spaceship: a pre-pulsar flanked by two sparks that stand in for the spiders pushing it. Full PPSs move at c/5, and their back sparks help build c/5 puffers.
35607cda4ef506c2b085d10be6019d18.pt: O núcleo de uma nave pre-pulsar: um pré-pulsar ladeado por duas faíscas que fazem as vezes dos spiders que o empurram. As PPS completas andam a c/5, e suas faíscas traseiras ajudam a montar puffers c/5.

182b1bd4a1035532b7a748a2f2ba4653.name: Salvo
182b1bd4a1035532b7a748a2f2ba4653.en: Three gliders flying the same way turn a block into an LWSS. The first two must be exactly spaced; the third, which removes a leftover loaf, can arrive at any time.
182b1bd4a1035532b7a748a2f2ba4653.pt: Três planadores na mesma direção transformam um bloco numa nave leve (LWSS). Os dois primeiros precisam de espaçamento exato; o terceiro, que apaga um loaf residual, pode chegar a qualquer momento.

2f14e31a4dde4727a69fcbc8d1c7716d.name: Symmetric
2f14e31a4dde4727a69fcbc8d1c7716d.en: Illustrates symmetry in Life: shapes that look the same after rotating or flipping. With odd symmetry the mirror line runs through a row of cells; with even symmetry, between two rows.
2f14e31a4dde4727a69fcbc8d1c7716d.pt: Ilustra a simetria no Jogo da Vida: formas que ficam iguais depois de giradas ou espelhadas. Na simetria ímpar, o eixo passa por uma fileira de células; na par, passa entre duas fileiras.

0d757837d2c4db9a04d43c323584913f.name: Tetromino
0d757837d2c4db9a04d43c323584913f.en: All five tetrominoes, the four-cell polyominoes, in a row: one is the block, one the T-tetromino, and the other three quickly turn into beehives.
0d757837d2c4db9a04d43c323584913f.pt: Os cinco tetraminós (poliminós de quatro células) enfileirados: um é o bloco, outro o T-tetraminó, e os outros três logo viram colmeias.

1d58b6981be1b1a422044e4ee2114209.name: Unidimensional tumbler
1d58b6981be1b1a422044e4ee2114209.en: A single row of cells that evolves into a tumbler; found in October 1998.
1d58b6981be1b1a422044e4ee2114209.pt: Uma única fileira de células que evolui para um tumbler; encontrada em outubro de 1998.

42aa83b015843ab52ee3d2eb2dd73f4b.name: Z-hexomino
42aa83b015843ab52ee3d2eb2dd73f4b.en: One of the 35 hexominoes; it forms part of the pentoad and of Achim's p144. On its own it dies out after 45 generations.
42aa83b015843ab52ee3d2eb2dd73f4b.pt: Um dos 35 hexominós; faz parte do pentoad e do Achim's p144. Sozinho, desaparece após 45 gerações.
